mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_booking (service_id, user_id, contact_name, contact_phone, remark, status) VALUES (#{serviceId}, #{userId}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{remark}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, service_id, user_id, contact_name, contact_phone, remark, status, created_at, updated_at FROM service_booking WHERE service_id = #{serviceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'BOOKED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
